rules.statement: When editing a wrapped comment-based help block (such as a PowerShell .DESCRIPTION), rewrap the edited paragraph so no line runs past the wrap width the rest of the block uses.
rules.why: A line that runs past the block's wrap width makes the help text read inconsistently with the rest of the block.
rules.check: Look at added or changed lines in help or doc comment blocks and compare their length with the column width the unchanged lines in the same block wrap at.

rules.statement: When a change widens what a script or tool does, update every place that describes it, including CONTRIBUTING.md, README tables and the script's own parameter help, not just one of them.
rules.why: Contributors who read a description that wasn't updated won't know the run now covers more, and may be surprised by its output or failures.
rules.check: For a change to a tool's behavior, search CONTRIBUTING.md, README and the tool's help (.SYNOPSIS/.DESCRIPTION/.PARAMETER) for descriptions of that tool and check that each one reflects the new behavior.
